scientific_question: With every observed input available by a fixed historical cutoff, can source-origin tags improve inference of a later age-dependent ecological state, beyond a cutoff-time occupancy census?

known_by_cutoff_under_idealized_model: locations of all three potential sources
complete exact equilibrium-reachable non-source node census at cutoff
world_and_information_contract.baseline_observation: one complete exact non-source-node binary occupancy census at a fixed cutoff time; do NOT include t=4,5,6,8 snapshots whose dates exceed cutoff
world_and_information_contract.candidate_information: noisy source-of-earliest-arrival tags ONLY at non-source nodes already occupied at that cutoff; no tag of a not-yet-occupied node is available even if its future source is predictable in simulator

targets.persistent_threshold_lag2: exact v26 rule: for equilibrium non-source node, Boolean(T-target first_arrival >= 2), absent/not-yet-arrived node False
targets.transient_window_age1_2: exact v26 rule: Boolean(1 <= target_t-first_arrival < 3), absent/not-yet-arrived node False

measurement.static_confluence: same v39 site order: descending count of graph-reachable potential sources then node ID; not activation or latent source-tag readout
measurement.static_random: same v39 one fixed seed eog-v39-20261019-fixed-rank, topology/node IDs only
measurement.cutoff_occupied_confluence: sort source-count>=2 potential confluence sites that are ALREADY occupied under observed cutoff-time occupancy by descending potential-source count then node ID, choose <=3; may condition on cutoff observation, never a future event
measurement.tag_category_likelihood: v39-like per-node categorical tag labels across possible candidate histories at that cutoff; missing prob 1-q if occupied, true-tag 1-e otherwise uniform other tags+synthetic UNSEEN; site not occupied produces deterministically missing, not a future tag
measurement.perfect_observed_tag_control: q=1, e=0, still only from occupied cutoff nodes
measurement.zero_coverage_control: q=0, e=.1 gives no additional information

analysis.target_metric: exact conditional mutual information I(target(t+h); tags acquired by cutoff | exact occupancy at cutoff) and incremental optimal Bayes accuracy, summing over all possible simulated target/report outcomes
analysis.primary_denominator: same 768 base worlds, separately identify cases where target is not already determined by cutoff occupancy
report_per_target_panel_policy: target ambiguous under as-of cutoff occupancy

predeclared_hypotheses.rule: at cutoff t=2 target t=5, at least one design's lag2 maturity target differs between histories matching cutoff occupancy; if none REFUTED
at cutoff t=2 target t=5, at least one cutoff-occupancy-ambiguous maturity design gets >1e-9 bit from actual cutoff-available noisy tags under occupied-confluence policy; if none REFUTED
all site-tag measurements at nodes not occupied at cutoff are deterministically unavailable, q and e cannot make them available; fail on any such simulated readout

at cutoff t=4 target t=6, lag2 mature map exactly equals cutoff occupancy at each equilibrium non-source node for all 3 histories/all worlds, hence 0 conditional target entropy and 0 incremental source information
in primary cutoff t=2 target t=5 maturity-ambiguous worlds, mean noisy MI from occupied-confluence policy > static-confluence MI by >1e-9 bit; may REFUTE
for every world/panel/target/policy, correct-likelihood perfect q1e0 cutoff-available tag MI >= noisy q.6/e.1 MI within 1e-9 and correct-history Bayes expected accuracy cannot decrease

negative_controls: under q=0 all tag mutual information and Bayes accuracy gain are zero
unknown true activation history never used in source-tag site selection
no t>cutoff occupancy or earliest-source LABEL ever represented as observation
historic 2026/genetic Dryad source never read; all 768 source graph rows unchanged
future target is evaluated at fixed time>cutoff, not original Tstar conditioned on later complete source knowledge
old v43 12/12 retrospective rescue is not reused as a prospective result
